D/ IMP LICINIVS PF AVG ; R/ GENIO POP ROM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Licinius I (308-324), smaller module Genio Pop Rom issue of 307-317, Reece period 15; Lyon mint, not found with this mintmark in RIC vol. 7. Obverse description: head laureate right with beard of fine strokes. Obverse inscription: IMP LICINIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left holding patera and cornucopiae, cloak over left arm. Reverse inscription:…
